# Part 1: Preprocessing

## 1.0 Cache check

```{r preprocessing-cache-check}
qc_method <- "osca_3mad"
preprocessing_output <- file.path(path$objects, "03R_xALD_filtered_integrated.qs")
preprocessing_force_recompute <- FALSE
preprocessing_cached <- file.exists(preprocessing_output) && !preprocessing_force_recompute

if (preprocessing_cached) {
  message("Part 1: loading cached xALD_filtered from ", preprocessing_output,
          " -- skipping recompute below.")
  xALD_filtered <- qread(preprocessing_output)
} else {
  message("Part 1: no cache found (or recompute forced) -- running from raw input.")
}
```

## 1.1 Load Data

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
raw_data_dir <- path$raw_data

norm_dir <- function(x) sub("PBMCS$", "PBMC", toupper(gsub("-", "_", x)))
raw_dirs <- list.files(raw_data_dir)
raw_dirs <- raw_dirs[file.exists(file.path(raw_data_dir, raw_dirs, "raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))]
ca_dirs  <- grep("^CA_", raw_dirs, value = TRUE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(norm_dir(ca_dirs)))

col_data_xALD <- read_csv(path$sample_metadata) %>%
  filter(diagnosis != "ALSP") %>%
  filter(sex == "m") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient_ID = toupper(patient_ID),
    sample_key = paste(patient_ID, type, sep = "_"),
    ca_dir = ca_dirs[match(norm_dir(paste0("CA_", sample_key)), norm_dir(ca_dirs))],
    dir_match = case_when(sample_ID %in% raw_dirs ~ "sample_ID", !is.na(ca_dir) ~ "CA_patient", TRUE ~ "none"),
    dir = file.path(raw_data_dir, ifelse(sample_ID %in% raw_dirs, sample_ID, ca_dir))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!sample_key %in% readr::read_csv(path$excluded_samples, show_col_types = FALSE)$sample_key)
```

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
col_data_xALD %>% dplyr::count(type, diagnosis)
col_data_xALD %>% dplyr::count(dir_match)
col_data_xALD %>% dplyr::select(sample_key, sample_ID, dir_match, dir) %>% print(n = Inf)
h5_missing <- col_data_xALD$sample_key[!file.exists(file.path(col_data_xALD$dir, "raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))]
if (length(h5_missing)) stop("no raw folder for: ", paste(h5_missing, collapse = ", "))
setdiff(raw_dirs, basename(col_data_xALD$dir))
```

## 1.2 SoupX

### 1.2.1 preliminary clustering

### 1.2.2 preparation for soupX

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 5000 * 1024^2)
emptydrops_fdr <- 0.001
soupx_output <- file.path(path$objects, paste0("01R_xALD_soupx_merged_fdr", emptydrops_fdr, ".qs"))
soupx_cached <- file.exists(soupx_output)
if (soupx_cached) seu_corrected <- qread(soupx_output)
```

### 1.2.3 loop through samples

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached && !soupx_cached}
seu_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(col_data_xALD))) {

  s <- col_data_xALD$sample_key[i]
  message("Processing sample: ", s)

  raw <- Read10X_h5(file.path(col_data_xALD$dir[i], "raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))
  if (is.list(raw)) raw <- raw[["Gene Expression"]]

  set.seed(42)
  e.out <- emptyDrops(raw)
  filtered <- raw[, which(e.out$FDR <= emptydrops_fdr)]
  message("  Cells recovered by emptyDrops: ", ncol(filtered))

  prelim <- CreateSeuratObject(filtered) %>%
    NormalizeData(verbose = FALSE) %>%
    FindVariableFeatures(verbose = FALSE) %>%
    ScaleData(verbose = FALSE) %>%
    RunPCA(verbose = FALSE) %>%
    FindNeighbors(dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE) %>%
    FindClusters(resolution = 0.4, verbose = FALSE)

  sc <- SoupChannel(raw, filtered)
  sc <- setClusters(sc, setNames(prelim$seurat_clusters, colnames(prelim)))
  sc <- tryCatch(
    autoEstCont(sc, verbose = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      message("  autoEstCont failed for ", s, ": ", e$message, " — setting rho=0.05")
      setContaminationFraction(sc, 0.05)
    }
  )
  out <- adjustCounts(sc)

  colnames(out) <- colnames(filtered) <- paste(s, colnames(filtered), sep = "_")
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(out, project = s)
  Key(obj[["RNA"]]) <- "rna_"
  obj[["RNA_raw"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = filtered)
  meta <- col_data_xALD[rep(i, ncol(obj)), setdiff(colnames(col_data_xALD), "dir")]
  obj@meta.data <- cbind(obj@meta.data, as.data.frame(meta, row.names = colnames(obj)))
  seu_list[[s]] <- obj

  rm(raw, filtered, prelim, sc, out); invisible(gc())
}
```

### 1.2.4 Remerge corrected matrices in a new SeuratObject

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached && !soupx_cached}
seu_corrected <- merge(seu_list[[1]], y = seu_list[-1])
seu_corrected[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seu_corrected[["RNA"]])
seu_corrected[["RNA_raw"]] <- JoinLayers(seu_corrected[["RNA_raw"]])
rm(seu_list); invisible(gc())

seu_corrected[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu_corrected, pattern = "^MT-")
seu_corrected$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(seu_corrected$nFeature_RNA) / log10(seu_corrected$nCount_RNA)
table(seu_corrected$type)
qsave(seu_corrected, soupx_output)
```

#### 1.3.2.1 Cell-level Filtering [CORE]

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
mad_out <- function(x, n, type) scuttle::isOutlier(x, nmads = n, type = type, batch = seu_corrected$sample_key)

top20 <- scuttle::perCellQCMetrics(LayerData(seu_corrected, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"),
                                   percent.top = 20)$percent.top_20

qc_keep <- tibble(
  cell      = colnames(seu_corrected),
  osca_3mad = !(mad_out(log10(seu_corrected$nCount_RNA + 1), 3, "lower") |
                mad_out(log10(seu_corrected$nFeature_RNA + 1), 3, "lower") |
                mad_out(seu_corrected$percent.mt, 3, "higher")),
  scbp_5mad = !(mad_out(log1p(seu_corrected$nCount_RNA), 5, "both") |
                mad_out(log1p(seu_corrected$nFeature_RNA), 5, "both") |
                mad_out(top20, 5, "both") |
                mad_out(seu_corrected$percent.mt, 3, "higher") | seu_corrected$percent.mt > 8),
  fixed     = seu_corrected$nCount_RNA >= 500 & seu_corrected$nFeature_RNA > 300 & seu_corrected$percent.mt < 10)

qc_keep %>%
  mutate(sample_key = seu_corrected$sample_key) %>%
  group_by(sample_key) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), across(c(osca_3mad, scbp_5mad, fixed), sum))

attr(mad_out(seu_corrected$percent.mt, 3, "higher"), "thresholds")

seu_corrected$qc_keep <- qc_keep[[qc_method]]

seu_corrected@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = nCount_RNA, y = nFeature_RNA, color = qc_keep)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~ type)

filtered_seurat <- subset(seu_corrected, subset = qc_keep)
ncol(seu_corrected)
ncol(filtered_seurat)
```

#### 1.3.2.2 filtering for duplets [CORE]

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
xALD <- filtered_seurat %>% SplitObject(split.by = "type")
rm(filtered_seurat); invisible(gc())

tcr_genes     <- c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G", "TRAC", "TRBC2", "CD2", "IL7R", "CD247", "LCK", "IL32")
myeloid_genes <- c("CD14", "CST3", "CD68", "FCN1", "AIF1", "CSF1R", "MNDA", "C1QA")

xALD <- lapply(xALD, function(obj) {
  sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(obj, assay = "RNA")
  sce <- scDblFinder(sce, samples = sce$sample_key)
  obj$scDblFinder.class <- sce$scDblFinder.class
  obj$scDblFinder.score <- sce$scDblFinder.score
  cnt <- LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  obj$tcr_myeloid <- Matrix::colSums(cnt[intersect(tcr_genes, rownames(cnt)), ] > 0) >= 3 &
                     Matrix::colSums(cnt[intersect(myeloid_genes, rownames(cnt)), ] > 0) >= 3
  obj[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, features = intersect(c("HBA1", "HBA2", "HBB"), rownames(obj)))
  obj
})

lapply(xALD, function(obj) obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample_key, diagnosis) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), doublet = sum(scDblFinder.class == "doublet"),
            tcr_myeloid = sum(tcr_myeloid & scDblFinder.class == "singlet"),
            hb = sum(percent.hb > 1), .groups = "drop"))
```

#### 1.3.2.3 Filter for erhythoctes [CORE]

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
xALD <- lapply(xALD, function(obj)
  subset(obj, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet" & !tcr_myeloid & percent.hb <= 1))

lapply(xALD, ncol)
```

## 1.4 Normalization & Integration [CORE]

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 5000 * 1024^2)
set.seed(42)

xALD <- lapply(xALD, function(so) {
  so %>%
    NormalizeData() %>%
    FindVariableFeatures() %>%
    ScaleData() %>%
    RunPCA() %>%
    RunHarmony("patient_ID") %>%
    RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap_harmony") %>%
    FindNeighbors(reduction = "harmony") %>%
    FindClusters(algorithm = 4, resolution = 2.5)
})
```

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
cluster_qc <- imap_dfr(xALD, function(so, ti) {
  med <- median(so$nCount_RNA)
  so@meta.data %>% group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), donors = n_distinct(patient_ID), max_donor_share = max(table(patient_ID)) / n(),
              count_ratio = median(nCount_RNA) / med, nFeature = median(nFeature_RNA),
              mt = median(percent.mt), dbl_score = median(scDblFinder.score), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(tissue = ti, .before = 1, seurat_clusters = as.character(seurat_clusters))
})
cluster_qc %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>% print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

### 1.5.3 Filter and rename Seurat Object [CORE]

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
for (ti in names(xALD)) {
  have <- levels(droplevels(xALD[[ti]]$seurat_clusters))
  done <- c(names(raw_cluster_labels[[ti]]), raw_removed$seurat_clusters[raw_removed$tissue == ti])
  if (length(setdiff(have, done)))
    stop(ti, ": clusters without a label or removal row: ", paste(setdiff(have, done), collapse = ", "))
  if (length(setdiff(done, have)))
    stop(ti, ": labelled clusters that do not exist: ", paste(setdiff(done, have), collapse = ", "))
  if (anyDuplicated(done)) stop(ti, ": cluster both labelled and removed, or listed twice")
  bad <- names(raw_cluster_labels[[ti]])[raw_cluster_labels[[ti]] %in% c("NA", "", "TODO") | is.na(raw_cluster_labels[[ti]])]
  if (length(bad)) stop(ti, ": clusters without a real label: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
}

raw_removed %>%
  left_join(cluster_qc, by = c("tissue", "seurat_clusters")) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  write_csv(file.path(path$tables, "allcells_cluster_review.csv"))

xALD_filtered <- imap(xALD, function(so, ti) {
  so$celltypes <- unname(raw_cluster_labels[[ti]][as.character(so$seurat_clusters)])
  subset(so, cells = colnames(so)[!is.na(so$celltypes)])
})
```

```{r, eval=!preprocessing_cached}
xALD_filtered <- lapply(xALD_filtered, function(so) {

  so %>%

    ScaleData() %>%
    RunPCA() %>%

})
```

```{r}
ggsave(file.path(path$graphs, "dotplot_allCells_Cluster_markergenes_CSF.png"), width = 5, height = 12, dpi = 300)

plot_marker_dotplot(xALD_filtered[["PBMC"]], celltypemarkers_PBMC, "celltypes",
                    title = "PBMC", order = order_present(celltype_order_PBMC, xALD_filtered[["PBMC"]]))
ggsave(file.path(path$graphs, "dotplot_allCells_Cluster_markergenes_PBMC.png"), width = 5, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```
